name: adr-writer
description: Run an ADR-first development cycle that authors, implements, reviews, synchronizes, and rolls up architecture decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Keep architecture decisions aligned with code
interface.longDescription: Author decision records before implementation, implement accepted decisions in dependency order, review decision fidelity, detect code-to-ADR drift, and consolidate superseded decision chains. A bundled hook surfaces the ADR map on each user turn.
defaultPrompt: Write an ADR for this architectural decision.
Implement the next proposed ADR and verify it.
Review my existing ADRs for quality and abstraction level.
Adversarially review this ADR implementation and produce a junior repair guide.
Audit the current ADRs against the shipping code.
